notes.title: Today is the day - a Difficult game about Wheelchair is officially out now!
notes.content:
The bold muscular man is ready to make your life difficult again!

It’s been a great journey — we learned a lot during the game development process, and we hope you’ll enjoy the pain, frustration, and small moments of victory just as much as we enjoyed crafting them.

Now it's your turn. Climb, fall, rage... and maybe reach the top.

Good luck - you'll need it 💪🦽

notes.title: a Difficult update about Wheelchair
notes.content:
Hi there!

For the past two months, we’ve been working hard to bring this major update to life. We focused on fine-tuning the controls and improving levels to make the game even more difficult!

Levels

 The Forest and Construction levels have been extended with more obstacles and challenges.
 A brand-new Amusement Park / Circus level with lots of interactive blocks!

Quality of Life

 We heard your feedback on the camera, so we’ve made it smoother and added a free-look feature.
 Auto-saving is here! Come back anytime and keep your progress.
 Basic configuration options added.


Update the game and don’t let the wheels get cold!
